hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; bash -c 'f=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" --no-replace-objects show refs/remotes/origin/develop:scripts/cloud-setup.sh 2>/dev/null) || { echo "Not run: the cloud setup runs only its copy merged into develop, and refs/remotes/origin/develop has none. Fetch develop (git fetch origin develop), and start a new session."; exit 0; }; SKIP_PLAYWRIGHT=1 bash -c "$f" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/cloud-setup.sh"'

bash -c 'f=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" --no-replace-objects show refs/remotes/origin/develop:.claude/hooks/work-saved.sh 2>/dev/null) || { echo "Not run: the work-saved hook runs only its copy merged into develop, and refs/remotes/origin/develop has none. Fetch develop (git fetch origin develop), and it runs from the next reply on."; exit 0; }; bash -c "$f" work-saved start'
bash -c 'f=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" --no-replace-objects show refs/remotes/origin/develop:.claude/hooks/work-saved.sh 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; bash -c "$f" work-saved stop'
